prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit paint_mask_guide.png as a texture-paint atlas; design_reference.png is the ornament/material reference and icon_x8.png is the colour reference only (magenta is not part of the object). Produce ONE transparent PNG, 1536x2048 or nearest 3:4 size.
Follow this brief exactly:
# Prote der Solle: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10148/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: preserve the upright dark-gold oval shield, pale rim, ornate border, and green-gold four-way swirling emblem.
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure yellow #FFFF00: every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: preserve the upright dark-gold oval shield, pale rim, ornate border, and green-gold four-way swirling emblem

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10148/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

Critical geometry instruction: the guide is authoritative even where the named views look unusual. There are FOUR thin curved edge strips and ONE large upright oval per half: row 1 has three thin strips, row 2 has one thin strip in column 1 and the oval in column 2, column 3 empty. Repeat the exact silhouettes in rows 3 and 4 for masks. Do not replace any thin strip with a full shield face. Do not add straps, handles or new geometry. Keep all object positions, outlines, sizes and existing gaps exactly. The large oval receives the reference's ornament fitted INSIDE its existing outline. All upper views unlit base colour, without illumination or shading baked in. Bottom half material IDs must be pure flat colours with no texture or lighting: red metal, green leather/fur, yellow matte nonmetal, black enamel/glass/gems; assign according to the reference material. Background truly transparent, including empty cells. No labels or grid lines.
CORRECTION: The previous attempt had scattered red/yellow flecks and expanded edges outside the silhouettes. Strictly preserve the guide's alpha silhouette: absolutely no stray pixels, no raised decoration beyond the edge strips, no extra marks or debris. Clean contiguous silhouettes only. Metal dark gold/bronze/copper and pale rim are all RED in the material mask, not yellow; the green/blue enamel inlay is BLACK. Do not interpret metallic gold as wood/yellow. Use the original guide for exact layout and clean outlines.

validation.visual_limitations: Stray pixels remain outside silhouettes after the one allowed corrective regeneration; strict silhouette and flat material-mask requirements are not fully met.
